description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing performance improvements, new language features, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK to version 25. Ensure build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) targets Java 25 source and bytecode compatibility. Verify all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images. Build and all tests pass successfully.
